51: And Beit Hillel hold ... it is not considered as though it was already collected - and we have here that she makes an uncertain claim, because perhaps she did commit adultery. Therefore, [the husband's heirs make a] definite [claim] and she [makes an] uncertain [claim], and "one with an uncertain claim cannot extract from one who has a definite claim". It is incumbent upon her to bring proof that she did not commit adultery.
